explanation.az: Kafedə heç vaxt kobud şəkildə 'I want coffee' deməyin. Yerli insanlar həmişə 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Bir qəhvə istərdim, zəhmət olmasa) və 'How much is it?' (Neçəyədir?) deyir.
explanation.en: Never say 'I want coffee' abruptly. Native speakers always say 'I'd like a coffee, please' (polite request) and 'How much is it?' (asking the price).
explanation.tr: Kafede asla kaba şekilde 'I want coffee' demeyin. Doğal ve kibar olanı: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Bir kahve isterdim, lütfen) ve 'How much is it?' (Ne kadar?).
explanation.ru: В кафе никогда не говорите резко 'I want coffee'. Носители языка всегда используют мягкую форму: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Я бы хотел кофе, пожалуйста) и 'How much is it?' (Сколько это стоит?).
explanation.es: Nunca digas bruscamente 'I want coffee'. Los hablantes nativos siempre dicen 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Me gustaría un café, por favor) y 'How much is it?' (¿Cuánto cuesta?).
explanation.de: Sage im Café nie schroff 'I want coffee'. Muttersprachler sagen stets: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Ich hätte gern einen Kaffee, bitte) und 'How much is it?' (Wie viel kostet das?).
explanation.fr: Ne dites jamais brutalement 'I want coffee'. Les anglophones disent toujours : 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Je voudrais un café, s'il vous plaît) et 'How much is it?' (Combien ça coûte ?).
explanation.it: Al bar non dire mai bruscamente 'I want coffee'. I madrelingua dicono sempre: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Vorrei un caffè, per favore) e 'How much is it?' (Quanto costa?).
explanation.pt: Nunca diga secamente 'I want coffee'. Os nativos sempre usam a forma gentil: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Eu gostaria de um café, por favor) e 'How much is it?' (Quanto custa?).
explanation.pl: W kawiarni nigdy nie mów szorstko 'I want coffee'. Native speakerzy zawsze mówią: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Chciałbym kawę, proszę) oraz 'How much is it?' (Ile to kosztuje?).
explanation.cs: V kavárně nikdy neříkejte úsečně 'I want coffee'. Rodilí mluvčí vždy říkají: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Dal bych si kávu, prosím) a 'How much is it?' (Kolik to stojí?).
explanation.hu: Kávézóban sose mondd nyersen, hogy 'I want coffee'. Az anyanyelviek mindig így kérik: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Szeretnék egy kávét, kérem) és 'How much is it?' (Mennyibe kerül?).
explanation.uk: У кафе ніколи не говоріть різко 'I want coffee'. Носії мови завжди кажуть м'яко: 'I'd like a coffee, please' (Я б хотів каву, будь ласка) та 'How much is it?' (Скільки це коштує?).

story.title: At the Morning Cafe

titleTranslation.es: En la cafetería por la mañana

story.content:
You: "Good morning! I'd like a coffee, please."
Barista: "Of course! Anything else?"
You: "No, thanks. How much is it?"
Barista: "Three dollars, please! Here you are."
